title: Updating the code-bound register
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating its register vector at index $5$ to $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its code bound $K$ with $z$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating the vector associated with
$\sigma$ at register index $5$ to $z$ gives the vector associated with the state
obtained from $\sigma$ by replacing its code bound $K$ with $z$.
